name: Are mother-in-law apartments permitted in Tampa Bay residential zones?
description: Yes, but designs must comply with local municipal zoning, setback rules, square footage caps, and specific standards for kitchen appliances and parking.

mainEntity.name: Are mother-in-law apartments permitted in Tampa Bay residential zones?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Tampa Bay region, including Hillsborough and Pinellas counties, mother-in-law suites and accessory dwelling units must comply with specific county and municipal building codes. Local regulations dictate minimum and maximum square footage, building height limits, setback distances from property boundaries, and parking stall requirements. If you intend to include a full kitchen with a permanent range, specific zoning designations apply compared to a simple guest suite with a wet bar. Reviewing your parcel zoning and utility hookup requirements with your contractor before drafting plans ensures full compliance.
